subject.title: fix(secrets): degrade stale auth profile refs on startup

question: Should a failed SecretRef on an automatically selected auth profile preserve the existing same-provider and environment fallback contract, or become terminal for every request using that degraded owner?
rationale: The issue requires preventing one stale profile from taking down Gateway startup, but the PR additionally changes shipped request-time credential precedence and fallback behavior; that compatibility choice cannot be inferred safely from the bug report alone.

options.title: Preserve automatic fallback
options.body: Keep explicit locked-profile failures terminal, but let automatic routing skip the unavailable owner and continue through healthy profiles and existing env/config credentials.

options.title: Adopt terminal degraded owners
options.body: Make all degraded-owner failures terminal, with explicit maintainer approval, updated credential semantics, upgrade guidance, and real proof for existing fallback configurations.

recommendation.title: Preserve automatic fallback
recommendation.body: Keep explicit locked-profile failures terminal, but let automatic routing skip the unavailable owner and continue through healthy profiles and existing env/config credentials.

likelyOwner.reason: Prior merged auth/secrets integration history and current ownership of the rewritten branch make this the strongest available decision-routing candidate.
